chunks: 4529 - And 'Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Abu Basir, who said: I heard Aba Ja'far عليه السلام say:
Whoever has a wife and does not clothe her with what covers her nakedness, nor feed her with what sustains her strength, it is a binding duty upon the Imam to separate them.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the lawful authority who enforces rights
key_terms.امْرَأَةٌ: a wife; the woman in the marital relationship
key_terms.عَوْرَتَهَا: her nakedness or private area that must be covered
key_terms.يُفَرِّقَ: to separate, meaning to dissolve or enforce separation between the spouses
key_terms.يُوَارِي: covers or conceals, here meaning to cover nakedness

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about a husband who does not provide food and clothing for his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the husband's obligation to provide his wife with the minimum necessities of clothing and food. If he fails to fulfill these essential rights, the Imam has the authority to intervene and separate the couple. It highlights the legal protection of the wife's material rights in marriage.
